Hi Lena,

Thanks for reaching out.

PO 7170: confirmed in transit, with a delivery date of 2026-11-12.

On the reconciliation request: I'm not able to share the output of a full "all" order search. That list spans every customer account in our system, and order details (POs, accounts, totals) for other customers are confidential to them — I can't pass them along to a third party, including for audit purposes.

What I can do instead: pull the order history for Ironbark Tooling's own account so your auditors can cross-check it against your invoices. If that works, just confirm the date range or the specific POs you need, and I'll send it over. If your auditors need anything beyond your own account records, let me know and we can discuss an appropriate process.

Best,
Hana
